stage1.description: Between Day 1 and Day 2: Body shop submits revised estimate

email.subject: RE: Claim #MC-2026-4471 — Revised Estimate (Teardown Findings)
email.body:
Hi,

During teardown we discovered hidden damage to the subframe and rear structural members. We've updated our estimate to reflect these findings. The revised total is available in your claims system.

Key changes:
- Corrected rear-left item (bumper repair, not quarter panel replacement)
- Added supplemental: hidden frame damage requiring straightening

Please review at your earliest convenience.

Best,
Tom Reeves
Apex Collision Center
(951) 555-0288

changes.new: Supplemental: Hidden frame damage — straightening required

stage2.description: Between Day 2 and Day 3: Attorney pressure + silent policy change + fraud flag

email.subject: DEMAND: Immediate Settlement — Claim #MC-2026-4471 — Bad Faith Notice
email.body:
Dear Claims Adjuster,

This office represents Michael Chen regarding the above-referenced claim. It has now been three business days since the revised estimate was submitted, and we have received no settlement offer.

Please be advised that California Insurance Code §790.03(h) requires prompt and fair settlement of claims where liability is clear. The police report establishes 100% liability on the other driver. The revised estimate of $52,800 is reasonable and supported by teardown evidence.

We DEMAND a settlement offer of the full $52,800 by end of business today. Failure to respond will result in a bad-faith complaint filed with the California Department of Insurance and a civil action for damages including emotional distress and punitive damages.

Govern yourself accordingly.

Derek Wilson, Esq.
Wilson & Associates
1200 Third Street, Suite 400
Riverside, CA 92501
CAL Bar #287451
